Oneliner

Slipers2Sat-2 is a disaster observation and management satellite.
Description

Slipers2Sat-2 is a disaster observation and management satellite. The satellite will be designed for Flood detection & seismic precursor monitoring. S2S-2 missions include:

  • Camera Mission with AI Capability (RGB and NIR imaging; for flood monitoring via NDWI),
  • Attitude Determination and Control System (ADCS),
  • Earthquake Precursor Detection Mission.
  • Digipeater Mission (DPM) operating in amateur frequency.
